description:
Internet Download Manager (IDM) is a tool to increase download speeds by up to 5 times, resume and schedule downloads.


- Fixed a problem causing IDM download panel not to appear on some videos
- Fixed an issue where the antivirus "screen protection" feature would hide the IDM download panel
- Resolved the problem that caused a "403 Forbidden" error when downloading some files
- Video conversion has been improved and accelerated
- Fixed bugs
